svg.title: Origins music: three different trigger sets
svg.desc: Three separate song recipes: green rocks for Archangel, red radios for Shepherd of Fire, and prone 1, 1, 5 floor-plate inputs for Aether.

g.text: Origins music: three different trigger sets
BO2 Origins · Original reference diagram · not a gameplay screenshot
Spawn bunks; under Workshop’s upstairs bed; excavation scaffolding.
SHEPHERD OF FIRE · THREE RED RADIOS
Excavation scaffolding; Freya’s head; Crazy Place Fire edge.
Go prone and interact at both spawn 1 plates, then a powered Gen 5 plate.
Hold Interact on each object. Maxis’s six story receivers are separate.
Dead Drop · Read the accompanying steps for the complete route.
